tags.description: Additional hashtags, in addition to any included in post text and facets.

text.description: The primary post content. May be an empty string, if there are embeds.

langs.description: Indicates human language of post primary text content.

facets.description: Annotations of text (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

labels.description: Self-label values for this post. Effectively content warnings.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.

main.description: Record containing a GainForest feed post. A faithful port of app.bsky.feed.post into the app.gainforest.feed namespace. A reply (i.e. a 'comment') is a post that carries a `reply` ref; because that ref uses com.atproto.repo.strongRef, the GainForest appview can honour replies whose parent/root is ANY record in the commons (an observation, project, cert, organization, or donation), not only another post. Deprecated `entities`/`textSlice` fields from the Bluesky source were omitted in favour of `facets`.
